title: VITA: Vision-to-Action Flow Matching Policy
abstract: arXiv:2507.13231v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conventional flow matching and diffusion-based policies sample via iterative denoising from standard noise distributions (e.g., Gaussian), and require conditioning modules to repeatedly incorporate visual information during the generative process, incurring substantial time and memory overhead. To reduce the complexity, we develop VITA (Vision-To-Action flow matching policy), a noise-free and conditioning-free flow matching policy learning framework that directly flows from visual representations to latent actions. Since the source of the flow is visually grounded, VITA eliminates the need for visual conditioning during generation. As expected, bridging vision and action is challenging, because actions are lower-dimensional, less structured, and sparser than visual representations; moreover, flow matching requires the source and target to have the same dimensionality. translated_title: VITA：视觉到动作的流匹配策略
translated_abstract: 传统的流匹配和基于扩散的策略通过从标准噪声分布（例如高斯分布）进行迭代去噪来采样，并且需要条件模块在生成过程中反复融入视觉信息，这带来了大量的时间和内存开销。为了降低复杂度，我们开发了VITA（视觉到动作流匹配策略），这是一个无噪声、无条件化的流匹配策略学习框架，可以直接从视觉表征流向潜在动作。由于流的源点是基于视觉的，VITA消除了生成过程中对视觉条件化的需求。正如预期的那样，连接视觉和动作是具有挑战性的，因为动作与视觉表征相比维度更低、结构化程度更低且更加稀疏；此外，流匹配要求源和目标具有相同的维度。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了一个动作自编码器，将……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: VITA提出了一个无噪声、无条件化的流匹配策略学习框架，直接从视觉表征流向潜在动作，无需在生成过程中反复融入视觉信息，从而大幅降低了时间与内存开销。
en_tdlr: VITA introduces a noise-free and conditioning-free flow matching policy learning framework that directly flows from visual representations to latent actions, eliminating the need for repeated visual conditioning during generation and substantially reducing time and memory overhead.
